messages.subject: method = "mr" not working
parts:
Hello,

I'm analyzing a four-way cross, and when I run the scanone function with any method other than "mr", it works fine, but when I run it with method "mr", the lods for all the markers are 0.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] method = "mr" not working
parts:
method="mr" uses only fully-informative marker genotypes; for a 4-way cross, markers are almost always partially informative, and so most all information gets omitted.

If you're getting good results from method="em" or method="hk", I'd stick with them.

karl
